title: Inter can't pick a keeper at kickoff | Provedel or Martínez vs Shakhtar #Shorts
description:
A goalkeeper needs to know the night before, not in the tunnel. La Gazzetta dello Sport says Chivu will choose between Ivan Provedel and Josep Martínez only shortly before kickoff against Shakhtar; Inter are 29th of 36 in the Champions League with no points, per inter.it.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=49

REPORTED: La Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews, Oct 20 (the goalkeeper call).
CONFIRMED: inter.it, Oct 19 (the Champions League table).
Next: Shakhtar Donetsk at San Siro, Wednesday, October 21 — 3:00 PM ET · 21:00 CEST · US TV: CBSSN, Paramount+, ViX.

Voiceover only — no music.
